resources.string: Welcome to Tradingin Aja! You start with virtual vRp 100,000,000. All assets are fictional, and there is no real-money deposit or withdrawal. Pause the market anytime to think calmly.
Watch candlestick wicks, watchlist movers, and News feed headlines. News reflects evolving Market Regimes (Bull, Bear, Sideways, Crisis) — interpret carefully instead of chasing hype.
Before confirming any trade, inspect Bid-Ask Spread, Slippage, Commission, and attach an OCO Stop-Loss so one bad move never risks more than 1–2% of your equity.
Check Portfolio for Drawdown, Risk/Reward, and Margin Health. Every losing exit generates an automatic Post-Mortem showing what happened and how to improve.
Advance through 5 Career Levels by completing risk missions, Candle Reading drills, and risk-free sizing practice in Learn. You can replay this tutorial anytime from Learn or Profile.
